tools.name: zenduty_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams in the Zenduty account with their unique_id, name and owner. Start here to get a team_id for the other tools. Zenduty API: GET /api/account/teams/.

tools.name: zenduty_list_services
tools.description: List the services of a team: name, status (0 disabled, 1 active, 2 warning, 3 critical, 4 under maintenance), escalation policy and unique_id. Zenduty API: GET /api/account/teams/{team_id}/services/.

tools.name: zenduty_list_escalation_policies
tools.description: List the escalation policies of a team: name, rules and repeat policy. Zenduty API: GET /api/account/teams/{team_id}/escalation_policies/.

tools.name: zenduty_list_schedules
tools.description: List the on-call schedules of a team with their layers, overrides and time zone. Zenduty API: GET /api/account/teams/{team_id}/schedules/.

tools.name: zenduty_list_team_members
tools.description: List the members of a team with their username and role. Use the username for assigned_to in the incident tools. Zenduty API: GET /api/account/teams/{team_id}/members/.

tools.name: zenduty_get_oncall
tools.description: Show who is on call right now, per escalation policy of a team (name, oncalls, unique_id). Zenduty API: GET /api/v2/account/teams/{team_id}/oncall/.

tools.name: zenduty_list_incidents
tools.description: List incidents with filters. status: -1 open (triggered and acknowledged), 0 all, 1 triggered, 2 acknowledged, 3 resolved. from_date and to_date take YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. all_teams: 1 for all teams, 0 for the teams of the API key's user. Results are paginated by page. Zenduty API: POST

tools.name: zenduty_get_incident
tools.description: Get one incident by incident_number: title, summary, status, urgency, service, assigned_to, creation and resolution dates. Zenduty API: GET /api/incidents/{incident_number}/.

tools.name: zenduty_list_incident_notes
tools.description: List the notes of an incident (note text, author, time). Zenduty API: GET /api/incidents/{incident_number}/note/.

tools.name: zenduty_list_incident_alerts
tools.description: List the alerts that were grouped into an incident: message, summary, alert type and time. Zenduty API: GET /api/incidents/{incident_number}/alerts/.

tools.name: zenduty_list_incident_responders
tools.description: List the responders added to an incident, with their response status (1 accepted, 2 declined, 3 pending). Zenduty API: GET /api/v2/incidents/{incident_number}/responders/.

tools.name: zenduty_create_incident
tools.description: Create an incident on a service. This pages the service's on-call people, so confirm first. Zenduty API: POST /api/incidents/.

tools.name: zenduty_update_incident
tools.description: Change an incident: status (1 triggered, 2 acknowledged, 3 resolved), urgency (0 low, 1 high), title, summary, assignee or policy. Fields you do not pass stay unchanged. Zenduty API: PATCH /api/incidents/{incident_number}/ (the live route takes the integer incident_number, not the unique_id).

tools.name: zenduty_add_incident_note
tools.description: Add a note to an incident timeline. Each call adds a new note, so a repeated call adds a duplicate. Zenduty API: POST /api/incidents/{incident_number}/note/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: zenduty_list_incidents, zenduty_list_incident_alerts · Private data: zenduty_list_incidents · Public sink: zenduty_list_incidents, zenduty_create_incident, zenduty_add_incident_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: zenduty_list_incidents, zenduty_list_incident_alerts · Private data: zenduty_list_incidents · Public sink: zenduty_list_incidents, zenduty_create_incident, zenduty_add_incident_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
